decisions.reason: As a very recently launched machine with dedicated website presentation, it carries fresh development costs and visible public commitment, so management is likely to continue backing it absent clear sustained failure.
The firm has already invested in engineering, market introduction, and standalone promotion for this 2023 launch, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although this rescue vehicle is probably a narrower niche product, its specialized development effort and public launch still make management more inclined to attribute any weak early uptake to temporary market factors than to exit quickly.

This compact telescopic loader appears close to the firm's machinery base and was given its own product page, so the combination of strategic fit and recent sunk investment favors keeping it on the market.
